issues.title: False Finding resolution from absence without resolution authority
issues.rootCause: Global absent-ID persistence transition treated non-observation as proof of resolution.
issues.closure: Domain/scope resolution authority, explicit verification status, structured resolution evidence, and carried unresolved Findings when reevaluation is incomplete.

issues.title: Machine-state fingerprint represented Fact identity instead of state value
issues.rootCause: Fingerprint hashed stable Fact IDs while observation values could change independently.
issues.closure: Canonical state-bearing representation sorted deterministically and hashed with SHA-256; volatile metadata and privacy-sensitive/raw diagnostic material excluded.

issues.title: Old scan cleanup could clear newer scan cancellation ownership
issues.rootCause: A single shared cancellation token had no generation identity.
issues.closure: RunOwnership binds scan ID, monotonic generation and token; cleanup/cancel/snapshot mutation compare authoritative identity.

issues.title: Broad WHEA/crash temporal coincidence could overstate correlation
issues.rootCause: The Phase 17 combined rule accepted hardware/crash coincidence across a broad multi-day window and emitted high severity without sufficient relationship evidence.
issues.closure: Explicit Weak/Moderate/Strong reasoning, tight pair windows, pre-crash causal ordering for Strong, recurrence/fatal semantics, conflict evidence, exact distance and rationale; weak coincidence does not emit the combined Finding.

issues.title: Volatile event timestamp embedded in resource identity could destabilize canonical fingerprint
issues.rootCause: Phase 17 crash/WHEA resource IDs contain event timestamps even though timestamps are observation metadata for machine-state fingerprinting.
issues.closure: Canonicalization maps event identity to semantic event category/state values and excludes volatile event resource IDs.

issues.title: Random cleanup candidate IDs and normal thermal variation could create state-fingerprint churn
issues.rootCause: Cleanup candidate UUIDs are intentionally random and exact temperatures are transient observations.
issues.closure: Cleanup opportunity churn is excluded from machine-state fingerprint; storage thermal state changes only when the documented attention threshold changes while reliability metrics remain state-bearing.

issues.title: New correlation branch contained a production panic shortcut
issues.rootCause: The logically filtered Weak correlation match arm used unreachable!(), violating the established no-panic-shortcut production invariant.
issues.closure: Replaced the panic shortcut with a total informational/low fallback while preserving the earlier explicit Weak-return suppression; enterprise adversarial audit returned 88/88 PASS.
